answer: The polisher rubs his candles with the soft cloth, and the cloth must bring up a shine without melting the wax. Spermaceti bayberry lye boiler wick bond is the rubbing: a bond bayberry lye boilers lodge after boiling room trials. The yarrow is the first rub, made at the bench; the zephyr is the last, made before the candles are wrapped, and the bridge is the cloth itself, yellow with wax. A forger would need 19 false rubs and 19 false cloths.
